name: dipper-monorepo
description: Monorepo for dipper: the `dipper` server/CLI, the web UI, and the packages they share.
author: Sumit Kumar (https://github.com/SumitKumar-17)

scripts.build: bun run --filter @dipper/web build && bun run --filter dipper build
scripts.start:site: bun --cwd=apps/site run build && bun --cwd=apps/site run preview
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run --filter @dipper/protocol check
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/scripts apps/site/src packages/ui/src packages/client/src packages/sql/src packages/protocol/src packages/protocol/scripts scripts && bun run --filter dipper lint
scripts.test: bun test packages apps/web apps/site scripts && bun run --filter dipper test
